    public function __construct($callback)
    {

part.text:
Fixed in `src/Illuminate/Validation/Concerns/FormatsMessages.php`: array-valued custom messages are now only returned when they contain the requested rule key, or when needed for size-rule type resolution. This prevents attribute-level message arrays from leaking into the `MessageBag` as rule names when custom rules fail.

Validated the reported reproduction and the relevant validation tests pass. The only remaining full-suite errors are pre-existing `ValidationInvokableRuleTest` failures unrelated to this change.
